titulo: The ENTIRE History of Amazon in 20 Minutes
descricao:
The history of Amazon and the Jeff Bezos story: how Amazon started as a bookstore in a garage and became a 3 trillion dollar company built on one thing, your impatience. This Amazon history documentary covers Jeff Bezos, why Amazon is so successful, the dot-com bubble, the Amazon flywheel, Amazon Prime, Amazon Web Services, the Kindle, Alexa, Whole Foods, and the FTC antitrust case.
